summary: A round selectable button used to pick one option from a group, with a label next to it.
description:
Modern Lit-based radio group (moz-radio-group) that groups and associates moz-radio items so they function as a single form control.

**A legacy XUL-style pair also exists** in the tree for older UI: <radiogroup>/<radio> (toolkit/content/widgets/radio.js, registered as tags "radiogroup" and "radio"). It implements roving-tabindex keyboard navigation (arrow keys, wrapping), a selectedItem/selectedIndex/value API, and dispatches a plain "select" event on selection, with attribute inheritance for disabled/selected/label/accesskey/crop/src.

**The tables below describe the modern one:** moz-radio-group and its moz-radio children, which is the actively-recommended pair.

**The native radio dot's color is not a radio token**, and radio has no token-api/components/ file at all to carry one. The checked-state color comes from `accent-color: var(--color-accent-primary)`, set once globally on `:root` in toolkit/themes/shared/in-content/common-shared.css (confirmed at commit 1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b), the same real token (`color.accent.primary.@base`) that drives button's primary fill, the focus ring, and checkbox's checkmark. Every native in-content control inherits it this way; it is not a per-component fact.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the fieldset is disabled.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Label for the group of moz-radio elements.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: Accessible name for the group when no visible label is provided.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description for the group of moz-radio elements.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Support page for the group of moz-radio elements.

attributes.name: headingLevel
attributes.description: Render the label in a heading of this level.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Input name of the radio group. Propagates to moz-radio children.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected value for the group. Changing the value updates the checked state of moz-radio children and vice versa.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether this moz-radio item is the selected one in its group. Declared by SelectControlItemMixin, and moz-radio sets `static activatedProperty = "checked"` so it drives activation.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon shown next to a moz-radio item's label.

slots.description: The radio group's content, intended for moz-radio elements.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: The radio group's support link, intended to be associated with moz-radio elements.

events.name: change
events.description: Bubbles up from a selected moz-radio child; the group updates its value accordingly.

usage:
<moz-radio-group label="Choose an option" name="example" value="1">
  <moz-radio value="1" label="Option 1"></moz-radio>
  <moz-radio value="2" label="Option 2"></moz-radio>
</moz-radio-group>

cssParts.name: fieldset
cssParts.description: The wrapping <fieldset>, inherited from SelectControlBaseElement (on the radio group, moz-radio-group.mjs).
